items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: When I played my first solo today and Herb Ellis went like this, I thought okay, that made my year.

ctx.x: Right. It doesn’t look like anybody is out to make anybody else look bad, like there’s a group thing.

That’s not the vibe here at all, as a matter of fact everybody is very encouraging. When I played my first solo today and Herb Ellis went like this, I thought okay, that made my year. He was either very angry or try to figure that out. No, everybody is pulling for everybody here, trying to — certainly as a rhythm section player my job is to, I say that what I do is kind of like the background to a painting, and the foreground is the soloist. So if the soloist is the Pope I try not to be hell. So I try to be the…
Would you consider some years as dues paying years in your career so far?
